issue.title: GRAD-02: Reproduce pinned WaterLily PR #285 CPU reverse capability

scope.purpose: Reproduce the pinned CPU Poisson VJP and two-step sim_step! reverse fixtures; capture the full-step outcome and tolerance effect.

runtime_fingerprint.gpu: not present or used in this CPU run

commands.purpose: full two-step sim_step! reverse from prebuilt sphere state
existing single-cell Poisson VJP diagnostic replay

mean_zero_poisson_tolerance_sweep.method_note: A process-local MultiLevelPoisson overload forwards a Ref-selected tolerance to solver!(; tol=...). It preserves the poisson_solve! function identity so the pinned WaterLilyEnzymeCoreExt custom rule is used. No package source or manifest was edited.
mean_zero_poisson_tolerance_sweep.timing_note: The first reverse call includes first-use Enzyme compilation. The second tolerance runs in the same Julia process after compilation, so those wall times are not a solver-throughput comparison.

legacy_single_cell_poisson_probe.scope_note: This exactly replays the existing probe. It perturbs one RHS cell and uses an uncentered pressure cotangent; retain as a separate historical diagnostic, not as a tolerance-sweep point or a substitute for the mean-zero fixture.

full_sim_step_reverse.exception: no method matching MixedDuplicated(::Flow{3, Float64, Array{Float64, 3}, Array{Float64, 4}, Array{Float64, 5}}, ::Flow{3, Float64, Array{Float64, 3}, Array{Float64, 4}, Array{Float64, 5}})
full_sim_step_reverse.actual_log_exception_note: Both printed Flow arguments have Array{Float64,3}, Array{Float64,4}, Array{Float64,5} fields; Enzyme reports no constructor for the pair.

failure_locus.stage: Enzyme augmented-forward activity wrapper creation while processing mom_step!
failure_locus.waterlily_callsite: WaterLily/src/WaterLily.jl:116: mom_step!(sim.flow, sim.pois; λ, udf, kwargs...) inside sim_step!
failure_locus.constructor_definition: EnzymeCore.jl:220 provides MixedDuplicated(::T, ::Base.RefValue{T}) and the optional Bool form; the failing call supplies Flow and Flow.

full_sim_step_reverse.result_scope: This is a reproducible blocker for this pinned Array-backed fixture. It does not establish that every WaterLily CPU backend or PR fixture fails.

interpretation.result: The pinned custom Poisson VJP executes and its agreement improves markedly on the registered mean-zero directional fixture when tolerance tightens from 1e-4 to 1e-10. The separate two-step full sim_step! reverse does not return a gradient and stops in Enzyme's mom_step! augmented-forward path with MixedDuplicated(::Flow, ::Flow).
interpretation.upstream_claim_comparison: This local Array-backed fixture does not reproduce the upstream PR's full-step CPU success claim; fixture/backend differences are not isolated by this task.

limits: Executed on macOS arm64 CPU, not on a T4 or CUDA GPU.
The mean-zero Poisson sweep is an isolated operator-rule directional check; it is not differentiation through sim_step!.
The full sim_step! result covers one tiny two-step Float64 Array fixture and is not a universal statement about all CPU backends or upstream PR test fixtures.
No SDF, v16, force-qualification, production-adjoint, optimization, or target-physics evidence is produced.
